title: Welcome
description: welcome, the answer to hello: the node is connected.

protocol.description: The version the server speaks on this connection, major.minor.

heartbeatSeconds.description: Send a frame (a ping when nothing else) at least this often; the server closes a silent connection after twice this.

serverStartedAt.description: When this run of the server started (ISO 8601, since 1.5); a node keeps it and gives it back in hello.resume when it connects again, which is how the server knows it was down.
